title: Fissured Pod - Videos
description: Have you ever thought about growing up hearing that you can't be "someone" in life because you were born with a different condition? At Fissurada Pod you will find several conversations mediated by me, a host who was born with Cleft Lip and Palate and also a Podcaster. The message that I will reverberate to the world is that a person born with a cleft CAN be whatever they want!!! You will see many real examples of this. We will address topics ranging from birth to the beginning of human relationships such as achievements, self-esteem, self-worth, internal relationships and relationships with others. Come check!
